responses.content:
{
  "price_image_only": "Your price is drawn inside a picture, so shopping assistants can't read it. Type the price as normal text on the product page instead.",
  "jsonld_missing": "Add a small hidden product description block (Product JSON-LD) to the page with the name, SKU, price, currency and stock status, so assistants can read the facts directly.",
  "stock_missing": "Say clearly on the page whether the item is in stock, and include the same status in the product description block.",
  "buy_button_nonsemantic": "Swap the 'Go', 'Continue' and 'Proceed' boxes for one real button that says 'Buy now' or 'Add to cart'.",
  "extra_form_step": "Take out the extra details form before payment, or make its questions optional and ask after the purchase."
}
